title: Implement GraphQLArtifactStore
description:
Purpose: Implement the single application-authorized artifact byte-transfer client.

Owned scope:
- Ticket batching through the frozen GraphQL contract.
- HTTPS upload and download.
- SHA-256 and size validation.
- Upload bytes before persisting metadata pointers.
- Preserve _s3_key while adding checksum, size, and content type.
- Retry once by requesting a new ticket only when a signed URL expires.

Exclusions:
- Direct S3, inline-data, API-key, and AWS-credential fallbacks.
- Procedure, evaluation, optimizer, and task-specific migration logic.

Acceptance:
- Unit and contract tests use mocked GraphQL and HTTP responses.
- Authorization, transfer, and integrity errors fail closed.
- Tests prove no boto3 S3 client is constructed.
